How Booking Works

Three steps, all over WhatsApp.

1 Choose

Pick your room type

Decide between a single, bedsitter, double, one-bedroom or two-bedroom unit and note its deposit amount above.

2 Pay

Send the deposit via M-Pesa

Send the deposit to 0799 922 637 (Dr. David, manager) to hold the room.

3 Confirm

Send your M-Pesa code on WhatsApp

Message the M-Pesa reference code, your name and chosen room type to the same number to confirm your booking.
